completion.rule: at every poll of unit size (Delta = 1) the poll set is the union of the rounded OrthoMADS directions and the POLL COMPLETION: every bound-, rule- and budget-feasible canonical lattice point within l_inf distance 1 of the incumbent in the 7 variables (zP5, zE5, zP7, zE7, zP9, zE9, zY); if the completion has more than 30 feasible points the poll is refused (nothing evaluated, never truncated) and the run STOPS FOR REVIEW (STOP_FOR_REVIEW_completion_cap); the cap is checked before the evaluation budget

peak_rss.units: bytes on macOS/BSD, kilobytes on Linux (ru_maxrss)
peak_rss.semantics: child_python_process = RUSAGE_SELF of the evaluation process at record time (the evaluation's own peak); production_state = the same measure taken by production at the end of run_operational_planning; solver_subprocesses = RUSAGE_CHILDREN max over the IPOPT executables this evaluation launched; when a post-certification step ran, child_python_process includes it (the ADMM run alone is production_state)
